# Constellation

The stat star chart.

`LL.Constellation` · Game Components · Character

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Constellation items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Constellation" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ConstellationProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `number` | Coordinate space; the component keeps this aspect ratio and scales to its container's width. |
| `height` | `number` |  |
| `items` * | `ConstellationItem[]` |  |
| `rings` | `{ cx: number; cy: number; r: number; strong?: boolean }[]` | Orbit rings in the same coordinates; strong rings are drawn in gilt. |
| `nodes` | `{ x: number; y: number }[]` | Points on the rings, drawn as short gilt ticks across the nearest ring (not diamonds: Foundations · Shape). |
| `selectedId` | `string` |  |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
